spans.title: The Make-Believe Bride
spans.blurb: Roped into posing for a moving picture crew, a girl and her reluctant guardian play out a runaway wedding at the blacksmith's anvil, and something in the game turns real.
spans.spoilerNote: His secret purchase of the wedding gown hints at the romance the book is quietly building toward.
spans.brokenNote: The text cuts off mid-sentence in its final line ('because, whatever happens, I'), so the closing thought never lands.

spans.title: The Court of Political Justice
spans.blurb: A newcomer watches a murder trial where both sides agree the defendant did it, and the only question is what the dead senator did to deserve it.

spans.title: Three Puffy Rolls
spans.blurb: A soaked, hungry young runaway arrives in a strange city with a dollar in his pocket, buys three great puffy rolls, and walks straight past his future wife's door.

spans.title: Arrested for Voting
spans.blurb: A deputy marshal rings the doorbell to arrest a woman for the crime of casting a ballot. She insists on being treated like any other criminal.

spans.title: The Girl in the Shop Window
spans.blurb: A lonely lumberman confides an odd secret: the mannequin in a shop window he passes every noon is breathing, and she is exactly the girl he has dreamed of.

spans.title: Bluff on Spaceman's Row
spans.blurb: Disguised as a shady freighter crew in a spaceport dive, two undercover lawmen work a scarred stranger for a lead, spinning lies they cannot afford to unravel.

spans.title: The Heretic Marriage
spans.blurb: An Englishman in Mexico loves a lady the Church refuses to marry to a heretic. He finds his own way to the altar, and the Church does not forgive it.

spans.title: The Silence Behind the Door
spans.blurb: Alone at midnight, a man lights strange powders, reads from an old book, and waits. The silence that answers is not the silence of an empty room.

spans.title: She Would Not Let Him
spans.blurb: A conqueror announces a prisoner will die tomorrow. The only thing standing in his way is a girl who calmly tells him no.
spans.spoilerNote: Reveals Elza's feelings for the narrator and the conqueror's weakness for her, threads the book develops slowly.

spans.title: The Burning Tower
spans.blurb: One charge in a borrowed weapon, one princess behind an electrified tower wall, and a city waking to alarms. A rescue with no room to pause.
spans.spoilerNote: Shows Wolfgar secretly working for the heroes, an allegiance the book stages as its own discovery.

books.pairNote: Separate episodes with different leads; the defiance scene and the tower escape share no text and neither gives away the other's payoff.

spans.title: The Midnight Search
spans.blurb: A jealous old husband storms his young wife's bedroom with lawyers and pistols, hunting a lover. She answers with the most magnificent scolding in Spain.
